subject.title: macOS update can leave manual-update loop and stale node host causing Gateway restart storm

question: Should #87928 own the remaining macOS manual updater-loop contract, including `manualupdate.*` cleanup, duplicate update dedupe, and same-version no-op short-circuit before service stop/restart?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent behavior is a product/update-lifecycle contract choice rather than a safe one-line matcher change because it affects update semantics and launchd cleanup scope.

options.title: Keep #87928 Canonical
options.body: Use this issue for the manual updater-loop fix and require macOS launchd proof for stale-job cleanup, duplicate invocation dedupe, and same-version update behavior.

options.title: Fold Into #85246
options.body: Close or mark #87928 as a duplicate only after #85246 explicitly absorbs the manual `manualupdate.*` job cleanup and stale node-host recovery scope.

options.title: Wait For Fresh Live Repro
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer or reporter reruns the exact macOS npm-global LaunchAgent update/no-op scenario on current main or latest stable.

recommendation.title: Keep #87928 Canonical
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the manual updater-loop fix and require macOS launchd proof for stale-job cleanup, duplicate invocation dedupe, and same-version update behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest current decision owner from the related macOS update lifecycle trackers and recent update/launchd recovery history.
